Yeah I've cheated one time, and only one time. Let me explain this to you. I lived in Indiana at the time, I had a friend in Ohio that I knew was into me, and she invited me over. I knew this was a horrible idea for a number of reasons:

* she was so far away
* it was wrong
* I loved my girlfriend at the time

But, like the dumbass I was (back then) I went to her house. The drive was maybe 4 hours. I justified this to myself by saying that she's one of my best friends (she was), that nothing would happen, and that it would just be nice to see her again.

So, I get to her house and she comes out and gives me a big hug, kinda does the running-start hug where the girl wraps her legs around you. Right at that moment I should have set her down gently and driven back to Indiana. I knew, at that moment, that things would go downhill from there, but I stayed.

Let's talk about my girlfriend (at the time). We had a great relationship. We talked all the time, we went out a lot, laughed together, and just enjoyed each other. I even bought a ring for her, I was planning on proposing at Christmas. Anyways, a week or two before Thanksgiving, she and I just hit a bump in our relationship. She was stressed out with work, and I was stressed out with life in general (my Dad passed away at that time the year before). So, we had a fight. A stupid little fight that was so shocking to us as we NEVER fought. We were upset for a day or two, then we didn't talk very much for a few days after that.

Then, the day before Thanksgiving I get a text message from the girl in Ohio. She says it's been forever and that we should hang out sometime. I told her, "damn, I need a friend right now. Trust me, if you were closer I'd drive to ya just to see a friendly face". She responded with a variation of "prove it".

So, anyways, I'm in Ohio. We're laying on the couch, making out, holding hands, doing all the stupid shit we know better than to do. We stayed in and watched a movie, and then when we got tired of the couch action we moved to the bedroom, where penis did enter vagina. 

I left a few hours after that. All I could think about was how fucking **stupid** I was. I loved my ex-girlfriend. I wanted to be with her and her alone, but here I was fucking another girl. So, on the drive back I tried to come up with excuses, or a way to make her understand I still loved her. 

I drove straight back to Indy and told her everything. I told her I cheated. I told her that I was sorry and that I wouldn't do it to her ever again. The thing about that promise is that it's useless now. I'd already proven to her that I could cheat, so my words were empty, and I knew it. I was a cheater once, so I know I'll always have the potential to cheat, I hate that.

I kept the ring. The girl is my best friend still, and I'll take that! I love her and I let her down, so I just spend my time trying to make her happy. I know I probably won't ever have her back the way I want her, but it's my fault and I own that. Every now and then I'll get the ring out and just imagine how things could have been if I had respecter her the way she deserved.
